# AffordableHousing.com

> > AffordableHousing.com is a comprehensive platform connecting renters and property owners with affordable housing options, Section 8 programs, and housing authority resources.

The site serves as a dual-sided marketplace featuring rental listings, Section 8 housing programs, and tools for both tenants and landlords. It includes enterprise solutions like RevoList and Central Hub for housing authorities and property management, along with integrated authentication, messaging, and application tracking systems.

## Key Topics

- Section 8 Housing
- Affordable Housing
- Rental Listings
- Property Management
- Renter Portal
- Owner Portal
- Housing Authorities
- User Authentication
- Account Management
- Rent Calculator
- Property Search
- Application Tracking
- HUD Programs
- RevoList
- Central Hub

## Main Platforms

- [Homepage](https://www.affordablehousing.com): Homepage for affordable housing search and rental listings
- [Renter Portal](https://www.affordablehousing.com/renters): Renter portal for Section 8 and affordable housing search
- [Owner Portal](https://www.affordablehousing.com/owners): Property owner portal for listing and managing rentals
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://info.affordablehousing.com): Enterprise solutions including RevoList, RentWatch, CentralHub

## Rental Search & Listings

- [Browse Properties](https://www.affordablehousing.com/properties): Browse and search available rental properties
- [Apartments for Rent](https://www.affordablehousing.com/apartments): Search and filter apartments for rent
- [Houses for Rent](https://www.affordablehousing.com/houses): Search and filter houses available for rent
- [Section 8 Properties](https://www.affordablehousing.com/properties/section8-owners): Section 8 properties and owner resources
- [Housing Authorities Directory](https://www.affordablehousing.com/housing-authorities): Directory of housing authorities and Section 8 programs

## User Authentication & Account Management

- [Login & Dashboard](https://www.affordablehousing.com/ll/dashboard.aspx): User authentication and dashboard access for renters and owners
- [Account Management](https://www.affordablehousing.com/ll/ll_myaccount.aspx): Account management for renters and property owners
- [Tenant Account Setup](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/tenantAccount/tenantAccount.aspx): Tenant account setup and management portal
- [Alert Preferences](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/alertPreferences/alertPreferences.aspx): User alert preferences and notification settings

## Renter Tools & Applications

- [Waitlist Applications](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/myWaitlistApplications/myWaitlistApplications.aspx): Renter portal for managing waitlist applications
- [Renter Messaging](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/renterInbox/renterInbox.aspx): Renter messaging and communication portal
- [Market Rent Estimator](https://www.affordablehousing.com/market-rent-estimator): Rent affordability calculator tool for users

## Owner Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing Plans](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/ownerPricing/pricing.aspx): Pricing plans for property owners to list affordable housing
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.affordablehousing.com/v4/pages/ownerPricing/Plans.aspx): Available subscription plans for property owners
